metadata.description: TaskDeck for Claude Code: the /taskdeck:track and /taskdeck:computer setup commands.

plugins.name: taskdeck
plugins.description: Track every task on your TaskDeck board and run your agents on your own computer. /taskdeck:track connects TaskDeck to Claude if it is not connected yet and turns Autotrack on for a repository or a workspace; /taskdeck:computer sets this computer up to run your TaskDeck agents.
